title: Send an email from the person's account
description: Send a new email from the account the person set up in the DSphere Agent Email panel (as that address and display name, through its SMTP login via the Native Agent); a copy is filed in its Sent folder unless the server files one itself.
guidance: It is mail sent as the person: write only what they asked for, to the recipients the task names. dsagent.mail.account gives the person's own address. To, Cc and Bcc together hold at most 100 addresses; the subject is one line and the plain-text body at most 50000 characters. An optional html body (tables, inline styles, links) goes with body as its plain-text alternative; it is rebuilt from an email-safe allowlist, so scripts, style sheets, forms and anything that loads from the network are dropped, and images show only by cid: of an inline attachment. attachments are files the caller staged first with the dsagent_upload_file tool (a path on the caller's computer, or base64 chunks), by uploadId; the Native Agent puts the file bytes into the message, the whole of which stays under 5 MiB. Requires an idempotency key: repeating a key with the same message while it is sending or after it was sent returns that result without sending again; a key reused for a different message is refused, and a failed call keeps nothing, so it may be repeated. OUTCOME_UNKNOWN means the server may have accepted the mail: look in Sent with dsagent.mail.search before sending it again. MAIL_ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND means an uploadId expired (staged files last 24 hours): stage the file again. When the person turned on Settings → File Uploads (off by default), they are asked in the DSphere side panel before a staged attachment leaves the computer, once per file and recipients: until they answer the call is refused TARGET_BUSY with businessCode FILE_RELEASE_CONSENT_REQUIRED (nothing was sent; wait, then repeat the call with the same idempotencyKey), and a no is POLICY_DENIED with FILE_RELEASE_DENIED (tell the person; do not retry). Replies to stored messages are not supported here.
